free_text_notes.physician_note: 52-year-old man with prior TIA, atrial fibrillation, admitted 3/15 with small right cerebellar infarct. Deficits stable for 48 hours; passed bedside swallow.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Ambulated in hallway with wife present. Need to update the PCP before discharge. A mild rash appeared briefly at the IV insertion site on day 2. It was assessed as a minor irritation, treated with a topical cream, and has fully resolved.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Met with patient and wife to review the discharge plan. 3/18 19:00: Atorvastatin changed from 20 mg daily to 80 mg daily on evening rounds. Patient and wife not yet told; this afternoon's teaching covered the old dose.
